description: This file defines the `AgentWorkflow` class, which provides workflow management and instrumentation methods for agent instances, including function replacement, execution tracking, event notification, and context management within a larger agent-based system.

classes.name: AgentWorkflow
classes.description: Workflow helper that keeps local execution metadata in sync with AgentField.

methods.name: None replace_function_references( self, original_func: Callable, tracked_func: Callable, func_name: str )
methods.description: Replaces an agent's attribute with a wrapper function to track or modify behavior.

methods.name: Any execute_with_tracking( self, original_func: Callable, args: tuple, kwargs: dict )
methods.description: Executes a function with automatic workflow instrumentation, including context setup, tracking, and error handling.

methods.name: None notify_call_start( self, execution_id: str, context: ExecutionContext, reasoner_name: str, input_data: Dict[str, Any], *, parent_execution_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Sends a 'start' event to the external system indicating a function execution has begun.

methods.name: None notify_call_complete( self, execution_id: str, workflow_id: str, result: Any, duration_ms: int, context: ExecutionContext, *, input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, parent_execution_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Sends a 'success' event upon successful completion of a tracked function, including result data.

methods.name: None notify_call_error( self, execution_id: str, workflow_id: str, error: str, duration_ms: int, context: ExecutionContext, *, input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, parent_execution_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Sends a 'failed' event if an error occurs during function execution.

methods.name: None fire_and_forget_update(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously sends workflow update payloads to an external server, with error handling.

methods.name: Optional[ExecutionContext] _get_parent_context(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the parent execution context, prioritizing the current agent's context.

methods.name: ExecutionContext _build_execution_context( self, reasoner_name: str, parent_context: Optional[ExecutionContext], )
methods.description: Constructs a new execution context, possibly as a child of a parent context.

methods.name: ExecutionContext _ensure_execution_registered( self, context: ExecutionContext, reasoner_name: str, parent_context: Optional[ExecutionContext], )
methods.description: Registers the execution context with an external system if not already registered.

methods.name: inspect.Signature _safe_signature(func: Callable)
methods.description: Safely obtains the signature of a function, with fallback.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_event_payload( self, context: ExecutionContext, reasoner_name: str, *, status: str, parent_execution_id: Optional[str], input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a payload dictionary for event reporting.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_input_payload( signature: inspect.Signature, args: tuple, kwargs: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Builds input parameter data for a function invocation.
